en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about eating the lizard. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The lizard, and the mouse, and the monkey, and the pigs, are morphed (creatures)’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about eating lizards. He (the Imam) said, ‘Lizards, rats, apes and pigs are metamorphosed.’”
